verdict.rationale: Recurly documents official client libraries for Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, and Go, plus native mobile SDKs for iOS/Android, giving AI-native developers concrete official SDKs to build against; it also ships a public MCP server (Compass) so AI agents/tools can integrate directly with Recurly's API knowledge. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality or reliability beyond vendor docs.
